sentences.text: Matthew Kerr (client) stated that Brian Hollis, who ran the junior squad at Harbridge Swimming Club, touched him in the changing room after training when the other children hadleft
Matthew Kerr (client) stated that Brian Hollis made him touch Hollis
Matthew Kerr (client) stated that Brian Hollis claimed it was part of being in the squad and that everyone did it
Matthew Kerr (client) stated that the incidents occurred every Saturday morning after squad training
Matthew Kerr (client) stated that the incidents occurred from when he was eleven until he was nearly thirteen (approximately 1996 to 1998)
Matthew Kerr (client) stated that he told his mother when he was 13, she did not know what to do, and she took him out of the club
Matthew Kerr (client) stated that he does not know if his mother reported the incident to anyone
Matthew Kerr (client) stated that he told his wife, Claire, in 2020
Matthew Kerr (client) stated that he told his GP
Matthew Kerr (client) stated that he went to the police in March last year and gave them a statement
Matthew Kerr (client) stated that the police officer interviewed Brian Hollis and the investigation is still ongoing
Matthew Kerr (client) stated that he has the officer's details (DC Farrow) in an email
Matthew Kerr (client) stated that he heard Brian Hollis did it to other boys
Matthew Kerr (client) stated that a lad who was in the squad messaged him on Facebook saying he'd heard the same about a couple of others
Matthew Kerr (client) stated that he never saw anything happen to anyone else himself
Matthew Kerr (client) stated that he has had anxiety for years and panic attacks
Matthew Kerr (client) stated that he had counselling through work in 2021
Matthew Kerr (client) stated that he is a site manager and had three months off sick in 2021
Matthew Kerr (client) stated that he has the sick notes from 2021
Matthew Kerr (client) stated that his counsellor wrote a letter for the police
Matthew Kerr (client) stated that his priority is for the club to admit it and say they let it happen
Matthew Kerr (client) stated that his second priority is money for counselling because the NHS waiting list is huge
Rachel Dunne (solicitor) explained that there is normally a three-year time limit for personal injury claims, which for a child starts at eighteen
Rachel Dunne (solicitor) explained that in abuse cases the court can allow a claim to go ahead outside the time limit, looking at why there was a delay and whether a fair trial is
Rachel Dunne (solicitor) stated that the claim could be against Mr Hollis himself and against the club if he was acting as their coach
Rachel Dunne (solicitor) stated that they would usually act on a no win, no fee agreement
Rachel Dunne (solicitor) requested that Matthew Kerr send the crime reference, DC Farrow's details, the counsellor's letter, and the sick notes by Friday the 4th of December
Rachel Dunne (solicitor) stated that she would request Matthew Kerr's GP records with his permission and would send him a form to sign this week
Rachel Dunne (solicitor) stated that she would write to the police to ask about the investigation
Rachel Dunne (solicitor) stated that she would send Matthew Kerr the client care letter and the funding agreement by Monday the 30th
